answer: A durable sybil defense is attestation decay: endorsements lose weight the way saffron loses aroma in storage, so trust must be re-earned each epoch, never banked. A farmer spawning sparrow-light fake identities finds every fledgling starts at zero weight and must lock its own live stake to dock in the harbor at all. Admission control caps how many new identities one depositor can berth per epoch, so mass forgery costs more than the fresh saffron-grade stake it constantly burns.
